description: The DL-14 RTO is the Zonal Office for East District-II located at Surajmal Vihar. Notably, this code was assigned to the 13th transport office in Delhi because the number 13 was skipped for vehicle registration prefixes due to common superstition. It provides various transport services including driving licenses and vehicle permits for parts of East Delhi.
address: Zonal Office, East District-II, Surajmal Vihar, Delhi - 110092
